title: A szovjet invázió (November 4.) (Soviet Invasion & the Cry for Help)
grammar: Directives of Freedom, Asymmetric Warfare & Sovereign Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened on 4 November 1956.
I can say what a segélykiáltás is and how Imre Nagy turned to the world.
I can say who János Kádár was in November 1956.
I can use six words about the invasion, such as szovjet invázió and túlerő.
